enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Dry body with towel. Wrap towel around body. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off water heater. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast (toast and tea) while checking phone messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Turn on toaster. Open kettle. Fill with water. Turn on kettle. Take out mug. Place tea bag in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Eat toast. Drink tea. Pick up phone. Check messages.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, packing work bag and reviewing the day's program schedule on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Take off sleepwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Put in laptop. Put in charger. Put in notebook. Put in pen. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open calendar app. Scroll through schedule. Read program details. Lock phone. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter office building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering emails and briefing volunteers
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at office. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open program documents. Review program details. Call community partners. Speak on phone. Meet with volunteers. Brief volunteers. Assign tasks. Answer questions. Attend meeting. Take notes. Update records.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to lunch place. Enter restaurant. Order food. Wait for food. Receive food. Sit at table. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Pay bill. Walk back to office. Check phone. Read messages.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: running program meetings, updating community partner records and planning upcoming events
enriched_activities.desc: Return to office. Sit at desk. Open computer. Review meeting agenda. Call meeting to order. Discuss program updates. Take notes. Assign action items. Close meeting. Open database. Update partner records. Enter new contact info. Save changes. Open calendar. Schedule upcoming events. Send invitations. Confirm attendance. Print documents. File documents.
Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Read messages. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place pot on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Cover pot. Wait for cooking. Turn off induction cooker. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and cleaning up the kitchen counters
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Turn on tap. Rinse dishes. Apply dish soap. Scrub dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in drying rack. Wipe counter with cloth. Spray cleaning solution. Wipe again. Turn off tap. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on the computer with the desk lamp on: replying to leftover emails and drafting program notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Open computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open word processor. Write program notes. Save document. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Night washing routine: showering and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Dry body with towel. Wrap towel around body. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off water heater. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and winding down with the fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn pages. Close book. Put book down. Turn off fan. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.
